text:
sara_sales: Hey team — Polybridge (trial customer) pinging about migrating from CompetitorX to Redwood. They want a short POC to validate prompt/output parity, security posture, and pricing delta. CC @jordan_se and @marta_security. They also sent earlier a 30-page security questionnaire; linking it in thread: https://polybridge.internal/qa.pdf :eyes:

jordan_se: Thanks — quick ask list so we can scope the POC: 1) sample request/response pairs (we'll run A/B with both endpoints), 2) exact function-calling schema if they use it, 3) streaming vs non-streaming, 4) target throughput and latency SLOs, 5) acceptance criteria for parity (e.g., token-level diffs, top-k match).

kevin_polybridge: Thanks Sara. Main goals: identical outputs for ~95% of calls, fallback to a cheaper model for non-critical routes, and cost predictability. Security: KMS for customer keys, SOC2 evidence, VPC peering or private deployment option. Timeline: POC in 4–6 weeks.

marta_security: Noted. We can run the security questionnaire but need to confirm: do they require customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) or is platform-managed KMS acceptable? Also ask if they require HSM-backed keys and whether logs must be forwarded to their SIEM.

nisha_legal: For contracts we need data residency assurances and a deletion workflow (how to delete retained caches/prefixes). Also flag for our Sales SOW: indemnity cap and export controls. Please send any required clauses.

jordan_se: Proposed POC plan (high level): Step 0 - NDA exchange + carving out POC data scope. Step 1 - onboarding sample dataset and mapping competitor API surface to Redwood endpoints. Step 2 - run parallel traffic (10k requests) with instrumentation. Step 3 - collect response metrics (levenshtein, semantic similarity, latency distribution, token usage). Step 4 - tune model mapping + quantization. Step 5 - handoff + acceptance run. For smoke testing, use this quick curl to compare outputs:

```
# compare competitor vs redwood
curl -s -X POST https://api.competitorx/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<<sample>>"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $COMP_KEY" > comp.json
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<<sample>>"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $RED_KEY" > red.json
python tools/compare_outputs.py comp.json red.json --metrics levenshtein,bleu,semantic
```

sara_sales: Pricing Qs from the buyer: ballpark cost for 1M tokens/month with caching enabled, and incremental cost for a dedicated pool or private deployment. Also curious about burst billing and reserved-capacity discounts.

ryan_account: Ballpark: hosted API ~ $0.0035 / 1k prompt tokens + $0.008 / 1k completion tokens (example model), so ~ $2.5k/month for 1M tokens depending on prompt/completion split. Dedicated pool pricing varies — expecting a fixed monthly commit plus reduced per-token. Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) includes platform fee + infra. We can put a 20% POC discount on usage and offer a reserved-capacity quote if they commit. Need expected concurrency to size Dedicated.

kevin_polybridge: Concurrency ~150 QPS peak, average response ~250 tokens, about 60% of calls are streaming. They'd like <200ms median latency on simple prompts.

jordan_se: For those numbers I'd recommend Redwood Dedicated (GPU pool) with autoscale and continuous batching. Enable prefix/KV caching for common prompts to reduce tokens (can cut cost ~30%). Streaming support: we have a streaming-compatible endpoint but note function-calling semantics differ slightly vs CompetitorX — we'll include a mapping shim in the POC to normalise callbacks. We'll also run small-scale latency/load tests: 150 QPS, 250 token avg, target p95 < 800ms.

marta_security: We'll need to share SOC2 report and our pen test summary. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our Private offering; hosted API can integrate with cloud KMS with constrained key policies. We'll prepare redacted artifacts.

deploy-bot: POC env requested: TICKET-5427 created. Staging cluster provision ETA 3 business days. Attachments: network CIDR for peering, IAM role to be provided by customer.

sara_sales: Action items: @kevin_polybridge to drop sample payloads + the security questionnaire answers into the ticket; @jordan_se to author POC test plan and mapping shim; @marta_security and @nisha_legal to prep artifacts and required contract clauses. Next sync scheduled Wed 10am PT. :calendar:

kevin_polybridge: Will upload payloads today and confirm network CIDR. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
